entities.summary: Robert Gabriel Helenius is a Finnish former professional boxer who competed from 2008 to 2023. At regional level, he held multiple heavyweight championships, including the European title twice between 2011 and 2016. As an amateur, he won a silver medal at the 2006 European Championships. He holds notable wins over former world heavyweight champions Lamon Brewster, Samuel Peter, and Siarhei Liakhovich.
